notes.title: Shadow Complex Remastered is Now on Mac App Store!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that starting today, Mac gamers can now play Shadow Complex Remastered! ChAIR’s award-winning modern and masterful sidescroller is now downloadable on Mac via the Mac App Store, Epic Games, and Steam.

Our goal with Shadow Complex Remastered is to bring the game to as many gamers as possible, and we’re excited to open up the game to fans on Mac. Explore the complex, find secrets, complete Proving Grounds and more, all from your Mac.

Shadow Complex Remastered for Mac is available on:

[url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/shadow-complex-remastered/id1126147327?ls=1&mt=12]Mac App Store[/url]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/385560]Steam[/url]

[url=https://www.epicgames.com/shadowcomplex/download]Epic Games[/url]

Mac Minimum Requirements:

- OS: OSX 10.10.5 (Yosemite)
- CPU: Dual-Core Processor, min 2.5 GHZ
- System RAM: 4GB
- Video Card: GTX 670M (1GB)

Mac Recommended:

- OS: OSX 10.11 (El Capitan)
- CPU: Quad-Core Processor, ~2 GHZ
- System RAM: 8GB
- Video Card: GTX 750M (2GB)

notes.title: Shadow Complex Superfan DLC Pack Released!
notes.content:
Shadow Complex fans, exciting news! Today you can pick up the Shadow Complex Superfan DLC Pack for just $2.99. Come [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/468600]check it out[/url].

The [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/468600]Shadow Complex Superfan DLC Pack[/url] features the complete remastered digital soundtrack, exclusive art and previously classified game assets, including the final Peter David cinematic script and much more!

Full List of Features:
[list]
[*] High resolution .jpeg displays the entire map of the Shadow Complex world in full color and high definition detail.

[*] The final draft of acclaimed comic book author, Peter David's cinematic script, with included game screenshots.

[*] Exclusive details including classified documents, blueprints, and enemy case files.

[*] Beautiful PC wallpapers featuring Shadow Complex landscapes in various resolutions.

[*] The complete remastered Shadow Complex digital soundtrack, including full versions of the 17-track game score with 3 additional licensed bonus tracks. Full track list below.

To celebrate the DLC launch, Shadow Complex Remastered is on sale on Steam for 33% off, today only! Also, come learn more about the fan pack in Wednesday's [url=https://www.twitch.tv/shadowcomplex]live stream[/url] at 4pm EDT.

notes.title: Join the Weekly Challenge - Win Swag and More!
notes.content:
For the past 3 months, each week we’ve been testing you with our Weekly Challenges. Players play one of the Shadow Complex Remastered Proving Grounds and post their best time to our forums. Each week we give out forums badges and other rewards.

You can learn more here: https://www.epicgames.com/shadowcomplex/news/welcome-to-the-shadow-complex-weekly-challenge

THIS WEEK'S CHALLENGE:
Proving Ground: Come On, Let's Jump
Goal: Highest Score
Deadline: Sunday, 7/3 11:59pm EDT

Here are the basics:

1. Each Tuesday we'll announce a new challenge featuring one of the Shadow Complex Proving Grounds.

2. Play as many times as you like trying to get the best time or score. 

3. Post a screenshot of your score or time to our forums. You must post by 11:59pm EDT each Sunday.

4. Each Monday we'll go through all entries and announce the winners.

Enter via our forums: https://www.epicgames.com/shadowcomplex/forums/showthread.php?271-Weekly-Challenge-15-Come-On-Let-s-Jump-(take-2)#post_0

notes.title: Join the Weekly Challenge - win Swag and Exclusive Badges
notes.content:
Here's how it works:

1. Each Monday we'll announce a new challenge featuring one of the Shadow Complex Proving Grounds. Join our forums and follow us on Twitter and Facebook to get these updates.
2. To play that week's challenge, head to Shadow Complex Remastered and hit Play, select Proving Grounds, and choose the title for that week.
3. Play as many times as you like trying to get the best time or score. Be sure to screenshot your results screen each time!
4. Post your screenshot to [url=https://www.epicgames.com/shadowcomplex/forums/showthread.php?246-Weekly-Challenge-7-Wall-Jumper#post_0]our forums[/url]. There will be a thread created for each weekly challenge. You must post by 11:59pm EST each Thursday.
5. You can also record video of your best attempt at post that as well. We will be giving out special swag to players who post videos.
6. Each Friday we'll go through all entries and announce the winners. The top 3 players will be awarded exclusive forum badges to display on their posts and profiles. We will also send out Shadow Complex swag on occasion.


That's it! So join in each week and try to lead the pack!

THIS WEEK'S CHALLENGE:
Proving Ground: Wall Jumper
Goal: Fastest Time
Deadline: Thursday, 5/5 11:59pm EST


[url=https://www.epicgames.com/shadowcomplex/forums/showthread.php?246-Weekly-Challenge-7-Wall-Jumper#post_0]Post[/url] your screenshots or video links to our forums before the deadline to enter.
